jobs.title: DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
jobs.description:
About The Lacroix Medical Group

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics
Operating Rooms
Biomedical Laboratory

The organization has experienced strong and sustained growth since its founding in 2009 and currently employs nearly 350 people. As part of its strategic plan, the Group aims to accelerate its national and international development.

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation.

The Mandate

In a context of sustained growth and transformation of its activities, Lacroix Medical Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology who will actively contribute to the organization's technological evolution.

Reporting directly to the President and CEO, the Director of IT plays a strategic role across the entire network. They are responsible for defining, structuring, and developing the IT function to effectively support the organization's operations, growth, and ambitions.

They provide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, business systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence.

He is also responsible for the performance of his team and the organization's technology partner ecosystem. This role is for an experienced, business-oriented, and results-driven IT leader who can combine strategic vision with excellent execution. Your Key Responsibilities IT Strategy and Governance: Define and deploy the IT vision and master plan in line with the strategic, operational, and financial priorities of Groupe médical Lacroix. Advise senior management on investments, risks, and key technological choices.

Performance and Business Continuity

Ensure the performance, robustness, and high availability of the infrastructure and technology platforms essential to the network's medical and administrative activities, including ERP, CRM, DME, LIS, SaaS, and cloud environments.

Digital Transformation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and prioritize initiatives to transform the organization through technology, data valorization, automation, and artificial intelligence. Lead major technology projects and ensure their effective integration into operations.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

Maintain high standards in cybersecurity, information protection, redundancy, and business continuity in an environment where system availability and the protection of medical data are critical.

Leadership and Organizational Performance

Lead and develop a competent, autonomous, and accountable IT team. Establish clear objectives and performance indicators, ensure rigorous budget management, and optimize the contribution of suppliers, consultants, and technology partners.

An Executive Role Close to Operations

At Lacroix Medical Group, technology must meet the realities on the ground.

The IT Director will therefore need to maintain close contact with the various business units and network teams to understand their needs, anticipate challenges, and ensure that technological solutions contribute concretely to operational performance and service quality.

The position consequently requires excellent mobility. The successful candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the Lacroix network in Quebec to meet with teams, support projects, and remain connected to the operational realities of the various facilities.

This on-the-ground presence is an essential component of the role and not an occasional responsibility.

The mandate expressly includes regular visits to service points.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an experienced manager with a strong business acumen and excellent technological expertise, recognized for their leadership, judgment, and ability to drive organizational growth.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

A bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field;
15 to 20 years of experience in information technology, including a minimum of 5 years in a management role;
Mastery of software architecture and project management;
A solid understanding of multi-site and cloud infrastructures;
Good knowledge of SaaS environments and major business platforms: ERP, CRM, financial systems, telephony, Microsoft 365, and others;
A thorough understanding of the issues cybersecurity, data governance and valorization, and artificial intelligence;
Proven experience in team management and development;
Recognized leadership in transformation and change management;
Ability to prioritize, make decisions, and manage effectively in a complex and evolving environment;
Excellent business acumen and the ability to communicate technological issues to senior management;
Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken;
A valid driver's license, a vehicle, and significant availability for regular travel throughout the network.

The Leader Profile We Are Looking For

Beyond technological expertise, we are looking for someone who stands out for their ability to mobilize, structure, and deliver.

A positive and committed leader with a strong sense of Accountability, the ability to build high-performing teams, manage rigorously, challenge the status quo, and transform technological challenges into concrete solutions for the business. The IT Director must be equally comfortable discussing strategy with senior management and understanding the challenges faced by teams in the field. Conditions and Compensation Lacroix Medical Group offers a competitive total compensation package including: Annual salary of $140,000 to $175,000, depending on experience and expertise; 4 weeks of vacation and 4 paid personal days; RRSP+ program with employer contribution; Cell phone allowance; Lacroix Health Credit; and an annual Lacroix gift card. This benefit can be combined with other benefits for personalized medical services.

Business travel expense account for trips outside your usual work area

Join a growing network and become a key player in the future of private medicine in Quebec.

Apply now and make a real difference.

jobs.description:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Risk Management

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

This role is an executive member of the Bank’s second line of defense Operational Risk Management function, which specializes in fraud, insider and conduct risk management as Head of Governance, Policy/Framework, Reporting and Risk Insights, and Emerging Risks. This role is Enterprise-wide, and works closely with Oversight teams in Canada and the U.S. to maintain Fraud, Insider and Conduct risk policies and frameworks, governance committees, and board reporting. Their team is also responsible for emerging fraud, insider and conduct risks, as well as QA and Enablement for the broader fraud, insider and conduct risk team.

Job Description

Depth & Scope:

Provides management leadership by hiring the best talent, setting goals, developing staff, managing employee performance and compensation decisions, promoting teamwork and handling any/all disciplinary actions, as required
Owns, manages and evolves the Fraud, Insider and Conduct Risk Frameworks, Policies & Standards to set a consistent and appropriate suite of controls for managing such risks within risk appetite and in line with regulatory expectations, and in consideration of the customer experience and customer friction.
Responsible for risk profiles, board reporting, RAS measures
Owns and drives Fraud, Insider and Conduct risk governance committees in conjunction with the Heads of Fraud, Insider and Conduct Risk Oversight
Reviews policy conformance, and assesses risk acceptances against the policies
Oversee the design and execution of ORM programs across the team, through maintenance of job aids and tools/templates, and review of the quality of the artifacts being maintained across the team
Centralized the initial review of emerging risks, through consideration of the changing fraud, insider and conduct risk and threat environment and evolving schemes. This may be done through as the initial point of contact for CRA's / NBPA's, or other emerging threat/risk work
Responsible for regulatory compliance management, and compliance monitoring and testing for our team
Responsible for maintenance of our own team's controls, RCSA, interaction models and RACI's
Builds and maintains effective relationships with business partners and control function partners, establishing credibility by understanding the business/control, their needs, strategic priorities and challenges
Partners with key stakeholders to drive fraud, insider and conduct risk management strategy in alignment with organizational and business objectives and risk appetite
Supports internal and external audits and regulatory examinations
Reports and escalates risk issues, events and breaches to executive management and risk committees
Partners with senior management and oversight leads on the reporting and presentation of fraud, insider and conduct risk, trends and key developments to the board, regulators and other key stakeholders
Fosters a culture of fraud risk management awareness and accountability for fraud, insider and conduct risk management, including identification, prevention, detection and response/reporting of such risks
Promotes and fosters a strong culture of integrity, ethics and regulatory compliance and provides independent oversight of the management of such risks
Maintains positive, honest, transparent and constructive relationships with regulators

Education & Experience:

4-year degree or equivalent experience; post graduate degree preferred
15+ years related experience required with deep subject matter expertise in Insider, Fraud and Conduct Risk Management and Banking
Experienced professional with technical knowledge of fraud, insider and conduct risk threats, risks and controls, and experience in the Banking industry (across the customer lifecycle from account opening, financial and non-financial transactions, fraud controls and case managers, and suspicious activity reporting)
Ability to attract, inspire, coach, train and lead; bring out the best in team members
Strong knowledge of banking regulations and industry standards (e.g., OSFI, OCC, FRB, FDIC)
Excellent leadership, project management and stakeholder communication skills
Strategic mindset with the ability to execute tactically
High integrity, sound judgement, discretion and a strong sense of accountability; ability to handle confidential matters with professionalism
Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize and react to discrepancies
Strong relationship building skills and the ability to develop and maintain relationships at all levels of management throughout the organization
Excellent written and verbal communications skills; ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and the ability to develop business communications calling for specific action
Communicate complex data related topics and transformational change drivers to the broader U.S. organization, including Regulators
Effective presentation skills, including the ability to present to regulators, executive management, and senior executive tables
Skillful communicator and influencer to build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, providing challenge and push back as needed and advancing decision making; effective collaborator with the ability to influence
Strong ability to analyze information and business situations and effectively collaborate with business partners on overall corporate direction
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize information across disciplines and functions
Ability to deal with ambiguity and facilitate and support change
Highly motivated with a track record of successfully developing and implementing large scale programs with superior results, while managing effectively in a highly matrixed environment
Effectively challenge business leaders while providing value added guidance
Works with a pool of experts and ensures high levels of service even when the effort crosses organizational boundaries
Possesses and operates with a strong Control/Risk Management mindset
Thrives in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment, managing multiple deadlines and priorities
Works collaboratively with others to innovate and simplify

Who We Are:

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information:

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Job Title: Director, Cloud & Kubernetes Platform Engineering

Position Summary:

We seek a visionary and technically accomplished Director of Cloud & Kubernetes Platform Engineering to lead the design, development, and evolution of our cloud-native platform capabilities. This strategic engineering leadership role is pivotal in building scalable, secure, and resilient cloud and container platforms while driving innovation in platform development across the organization.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in cloud platform engineering across Azure, GCP, and AWS and Kubernetes ecosystem development, and multi-cloud architectures, along with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing platform engineering teams. Your engineering leadership will be instrumental in designing foundational platform capabilities, developer experiences, and self-service infrastructure that accelerate the entire engineering organization.

Job Responsibilities:

Platform Engineering Strategy

Define and execute a forward-looking cloud and Kubernetes platform engineering strategy aligned with enterprise goals and digital transformation initiatives.
Own P&L responsibility, technology budget management, and ROI optimization for enterprise platform investments across Azure, GCP, and AWS.
Develop and implement platform engineering roadmaps that align business goals with technical execution plans.
Translate long-term platform vision into prioritized, actionable engineering workstreams.
Lead the development of strategic platform roadmaps to drive engineering velocity, scalability, and resilience.

Multi-Cloud Platform Development & Architecture

Develop our next-generation cloud-native platforms spanning Azure, GCP, and AWS enabling scalable, portable workloads across a unified multi-cloud estate.
Design and implement cloud-specific platform capabilities: AWS landing zones using Control Tower and Organizations; Azure platform engineering with Management Groups, Policy, and Blueprints; GCP platform design leveraging Organization Policies, Shared VPC, and Resource Hierarchy.
Build and govern a consistent cloud abstraction layer that normalizes networking, IAM, secrets management, and compute across all three hyperscalers.
Lead the engineering of cloud-native managed Kubernetes services Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, and Google GKE into a cohesive, centrally governed multi-cluster platform.
Design and build internal developer platforms (IDPs) that deliver self-service cloud provisioning, improving developer productivity and time-to-deploy across all cloud environments.
Lead the engineering of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) frameworks, CI/CD platform toolchains, and automation pipelines to support rapid, repeatable delivery across clouds.
Drive platform reliability engineering through proactive design, SLO-based engineering, error budgets, and scalable capacity planning.
Establish and govern cloud platform standards, blueprints, and golden paths for engineering teams to build upon.

Kubernetes & Container Platform Engineering

Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of enterprise Kubernetes platforms across EKS, AKS, and GKE, including cluster architecture, networking, storage, and multi-tenancy patterns.
Engineer a unified multi-cluster management plane enabling consistent deployment, policy enforcement, and observability across cloud providers.
Build and mature container platform capabilities including image management, runtime security, policy enforcement, and workload scheduling.
Drive adoption of service mesh, advanced networking, and observability tooling within the Kubernetes ecosystem.
Partner with security teams to embed platform-level security controls, pod security standards, and supply chain security practices.

Cloud Networking & Connectivity Engineering

Partner with the networking team on the design and engineering cloud networking foundations including AWS Transit Gateway and VPC architecture, Azure Virtual WAN and Hub-Spoke topologies, and GCP Shared VPC and Cloud Interconnect patterns.
Support the networking team on the build and maintain private connectivity frameworks such as AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and GCP Dedicated Interconnect, ensuring high-availability hybrid and multi-cloud network paths.
Partner with the networking team on engineering of DNS, traffic management, and load balancing platforms across cloud providers to support global application delivery.

Cloud Identity, Security & Compliance Engineering

Engineer cloud identity and access management platforms across AWS IAM and SCPs, Azure Entra ID (Active Directory) and Conditional Access, and GCP IAM with Workload Identity Federation.
Engineer cloud governance frameworks and embed compliance controls (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2) natively into the platform using AWS Config, Azure Policy, and GCP Organization Policies.
Champion platform-level security engineering practices across all cloud environments, including secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager), identity federation, and zero-trust networking.
Leverage cloud security posture management (CSPM) tooling and integrate findings into engineering workflows.

Team Leadership

Inspire, mentor, and manage a global team of cloud platform engineers, Kubernetes specialists, and DevOps practitioners.
Cultivate a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
Recruit, develop, and retain top platform engineering talent.

Cost & FinOps Engineering

In partnership with the Cloud FinOps team Design cost-aware platform architectures and implement FinOps practices to optimize cloud expenditure across AWS, Azure, and GCP without compromising performance or security.
Build tooling and dashboards leveraging AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, and GCP Cloud Billing to give engineering teams visibility into resource utilization and cost attribution.
Architect tagging strategies, resource hierarchies, and chargeback models to drive engineering accountability for cloud spend.

Innovation & Platform Evolution

Stay ahead of emerging cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes ecosystem developments, and hyperscaler service releases, proactively integrating capabilities that enhance platform value.
Drive adoption of emerging patterns including GitOps, eBPF-based networking, WASM workloads, and AI/ML platform infrastructure across AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, and GCP Vertex AI.

Qualifications & Critical Skills

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
15+ years in engineering, including 6+ years in cloud platform or infrastructure engineering leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale cloud platform engineering programs and Kubernetes-based transformations.
Deep, hands-on expertise across all three major hyperscalers: AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, Control Tower), Azure (AKS, Entra ID, Virtual WAN, Azure Policy), and GCP (GKE, Shared VPC, Organization Policy, Vertex AI).
Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes — including cluster design, operators, custom resource definitions (CRDs), Helm, and the broader CNCF ecosystem.
Proven experience engineering and operating managed Kubernetes platforms: Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, and Google GKE at enterprise scale.
Strong command of platform engineering principles: internal developer platforms, golden paths, self-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx).
Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (Flux, ArgoCD), and CI/CD platform tooling.
Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles — SLOs, SLIs, error budgets — applied at the platform layer.
Experience with cloud-native security engineering including RBAC, policy-as-code (OPA/Gatekeeper), CSPM tooling, and supply chain security.
Relevant cloud certifications preferred: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect.
Proven ability to drive cross-functional collaboration and deliver exceptional platform outcomes for internal engineering customers.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical teams and senior executives.

Office requirement: We are Flex and Connect with 2 days a week in office.

Relocation is not budgeted for this role

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Drive platform reliability engineering through proactive design, SLO-based engineering, error budgets, and scalable capacity planning.
Establish and govern cloud platform standards, blueprints, and golden paths for engineering teams to build upon.

Kubernetes & Container Platform Engineering

Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of enterprise Kubernetes platforms across EKS, AKS, and GKE, including cluster architecture, networking, storage, and multi-tenancy patterns.
Engineer a unified multi-cluster management plane enabling consistent deployment, policy enforcement, and observability across cloud providers.
Build and mature container platform capabilities including image management, runtime security, policy enforcement, and workload scheduling.
Drive adoption of service mesh, advanced networking, and observability tooling within the Kubernetes ecosystem.
Partner with security teams to embed platform-level security controls, pod security standards, and supply chain security practices.

Cloud Networking & Connectivity Engineering

Partner with the networking team on the design and engineering cloud networking foundations including AWS Transit Gateway and VPC architecture, Azure Virtual WAN and Hub-Spoke topologies, and GCP Shared VPC and Cloud Interconnect patterns.
Support the networking team on the build and maintain private connectivity frameworks such as AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and GCP Dedicated Interconnect, ensuring high-availability hybrid and multi-cloud network paths.
Partner with the networking team on engineering of DNS, traffic management, and load balancing platforms across cloud providers to support global application delivery.

Cloud Identity, Security & Compliance Engineering

Engineer cloud identity and access management platforms across AWS IAM and SCPs, Azure Entra ID (Active Directory) and Conditional Access, and GCP IAM with Workload Identity Federation.
Engineer cloud governance frameworks and embed compliance controls (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2) natively into the platform using AWS Config, Azure Policy, and GCP Organization Policies.
Champion platform-level security engineering practices across all cloud environments, including secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager), identity federation, and zero-trust networking.
Leverage cloud security posture management (CSPM) tooling and integrate findings into engineering workflows.

Team Leadership

Inspire, mentor, and manage a global team of cloud platform engineers, Kubernetes specialists, and DevOps practitioners.
Cultivate a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
Recruit, develop, and retain top platform engineering talent.

Cost & FinOps Engineering

In partnership with the Cloud FinOps team Design cost-aware platform architectures and implement FinOps practices to optimize cloud expenditure across AWS, Azure, and GCP without compromising performance or security.
Build tooling and dashboards leveraging AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, and GCP Cloud Billing to give engineering teams visibility into resource utilization and cost attribution.
Architect tagging strategies, resource hierarchies, and chargeback models to drive engineering accountability for cloud spend.

Innovation & Platform Evolution

Stay ahead of emerging cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes ecosystem developments, and hyperscaler service releases, proactively integrating capabilities that enhance platform value.
Drive adoption of emerging patterns including GitOps, eBPF-based networking, WASM workloads, and AI/ML platform infrastructure across AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, and GCP Vertex AI.

Qualifications & Critical Skills

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
15+ years in engineering, including 6+ years in cloud platform or infrastructure engineering leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale cloud platform engineering programs and Kubernetes-based transformations.
Deep, hands-on expertise across all three major hyperscalers: AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, Control Tower), Azure (AKS, Entra ID, Virtual WAN, Azure Policy), and GCP (GKE, Shared VPC, Organization Policy, Vertex AI).
Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes — including cluster design, operators, custom resource definitions (CRDs), Helm, and the broader CNCF ecosystem.
Proven experience engineering and operating managed Kubernetes platforms: Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, and Google GKE at enterprise scale.
Strong command of platform engineering principles: internal developer platforms, golden paths, self-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx).
Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (Flux, ArgoCD), and CI/CD platform tooling.
Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles — SLOs, SLIs, error budgets — applied at the platform layer.
Experience with cloud-native security engineering including RBAC, policy-as-code (OPA/Gatekeeper), CSPM tooling, and supply chain security.
Relevant cloud certifications preferred: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect.
Proven ability to drive cross-functional collaboration and deliver exceptional platform outcomes for internal engineering customers.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical teams and senior executives.
